# 7 Setting up your blog {#sec-blog}

## Why blog?

You might be wondering why a blog is valuable to you as a data scientist. Hopefully one of these convinces you it's a fun and worthwhile outlet:

- [5 Reasons Why Every Data Scientist Should Blog](https://towardsdatascience.com/5-reasons-why-every-data-scientist-should-blog-f1d81550a6c3/)
- [Why Data Scientists Should Definitely Be Writing for Medium](https://opendatascience.com/why-data-scientists-should-definitely-be-writing-for-medium/)
- [Unorthodox Reasons Why Data Scientists Should Start a Blog](https://towardsdatascience.com/unorthodox-reasons-why-data-scientists-should-start-a-blog-7529cdcf777/)

## Pick a template

I'm using [this template](https://flo-bit.dev/blog-template/), and have a template in my github repository for your use but there are lots of great ones:

- [Fuwari](https://fuwari.vercel.app/)
- [AstroPaper](https://astro-paper.pages.dev/)
- [Astroship](https://astroship.web3templates.com/blog)
- [Firefly](https://firefly.cuteleaf.cn/)
- [Chalk](https://chalk.nielsenramon.com/)
- [blog-template-gray](https://blog-template-gray.vercel.app/)

Set it up in your `blog` repo by following the template's README. It'll be at the following link: `https://<username>.github.io/blog/`.

You'll update the index.html NAVBAR section's link to your blog from the current example.com to this link!
